sql: SELECT TOP 10 azu.UserName AS userName, um.Id AS userId FROM cso.TblCustom_UserManagement um INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetZnodeUser azu ON azu.UserName = um.UserName INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetUsers au ON au.UserName = azu.AspNetZnodeUserId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeUser zu ON zu.AspNetUserId = au.Id INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeUserPortal up ON up.UserId = zu.UserId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = up.PortalId AND po.StoreCode = um.StoreCode WHERE po.StoreCode = @store AND um.Role = @role AND zu.IsActive = @isActive AND au.LockoutEnd IS NULL AND um.Categories IS NOT NULL AND LEN(um.Categories) > @zero AND (@preferred IS NULL OR azu.UserName = @preferred) ORDER BY um.Id
